title: Clarivate and ODIN to Launch First Multi-State Resource Sharing Network Across the Dakotas
summary: Rapido, Clarivate’s library resource sharing platform, to connect libraries across North and South Dakota, expanding access to collections
body_markdown:
*Rapido, Clarivate’s library resource sharing platform, to connect libraries across North and South Dakota, expanding access to collections*


**London, U.K. September 14, 2026** .[Clarivate Plc](https://clarivate.com/) (NYSE:CLVT), a leading global provider of transformative intelligence, today announced that Online Dakota Information Network (ODIN) has selected the company to power a multi-state, library resource sharing network across North and South Dakota.


The new cloud-based platform will connect more than 200 academic, public, state, school and special libraries of varying sizes that are operating a wide variety of library management systems into a single resource sharing network. The new Clarivate platform will help expand access to collections and support more efficient borrowing and lending across communities in both states, delivering value and better service to both libraries and users.


The initiative, supported and administered by the Online Dakota Information Network (ODIN), part of the North Dakota University System Core Technology Services, is jointly sponsored by the North Dakota State Library and the South Dakota State Library.


Jason Bedsaul, Director of ODIN, said: “We chose Clarivate’s library resource sharing platform,[Rapido](https://exlibrisgroup.com/products/rapido-library-resource-sharing-platform/?utm_content=press_release&utm_term=earned_press&campaignname=PR_LeadGen_AG_XBU_Global&campaignid=%E2%80%8B+701QO00000QviLVY) , because it can support the scale, diversity and practical realities of this initiative. Libraries across North and South Dakota use a wide range of systems, and it was key to create a network that meets libraries where they are with the current library management solution. For nearly 40 years, ODIN has helped libraries modernize services, collaborate at scale and deliver essential, affordable access to library resources for the communities they serve. Partnering with Clarivate will enable us to continue to do so.”


Yoel Goldenberg, Senior Vice President and General Manager, Library Software at Clarivate said: “This project demonstrates what’s possible when libraries work together across institutional and state boundaries. We are proud to support ODIN to remove barriers to resource sharing, empowering libraries in North and South Dakota to better serve their communities and advance learning, research and teaching.”


Mary J. Soucie, State Librarian, North Dakota State Library said: “The North Dakota State Library is proud to partner with the South Dakota State Library and ODIN on the implementation of the InterLibrary Loan Bridge. Implementing the bridge across our two states is essential to strengthen resource sharing and expand access to library materials, which will enrich the lives of both North and South Dakotans.”


George Seamon, State Librarian, South Dakota State Library said: “It has always been important for libraries to share materials to maximize resources and space. Through sharing, we can expand a library’s collection beyond what is locally housed. Together, North and South Dakota will in practice double our statewide collections, and leverage group purchasing so that we can continue to use tax dollars as efficiently and effectively as possible while providing the best services to our respective state’s citizens.”


The Dakotas initiative represents an important milestone for Rapido, demonstrating how statewide and regional library organizations, and consortia, can build collaborative resource sharing networks that connect libraries across multiple library systems.


The new Clarivate platform is expected to go live in the second half of 2027.


Learn more about[Rapido](https://exlibrisgroup.com/products/rapido-library-resource-sharing-platform/?utm_content=press_release&utm_term=earned_press&campaignname=PR_LeadGen_AG_XBU_Global&campaignid=%E2%80%8B+701QO00000QviLVY) .
